rows.v_note: FY2025 ended March 31, 2026: reported product sales JPY 63.1bn; converted at company actual FY2025 average rate JPY 151/USD (results presentation, pp.5-6).

loe.note: PMDA: eight-year re-examination from 2024-03-26; calculated end 2032-03-25 for original 100mg product. Not an announced biosimilar launch.

rows.v_note: FY2025 ended March 31, 2026: reported product sales JPY 77.6bn; converted at company actual FY2025 average rate JPY 151/USD (results presentation, pp.5-6).

loe.note: In the published Q3 FY2024 call, an analyst suggested 2030/2034 patent dates; management declined to provide a specific generic-entry date. The analyst question is not company confirmation of loss of exclusivity.
loe.note_zh: 在已发布的FY2024第三季度电话会议中，一位分析师提出专利日期可能为2030/2034年；管理层拒绝提供具体的仿制药上市日期。分析师的提问并非公司对独占期结束的确认。

loe.note: Orange Book: use patents US11273171/US11491176 expire 2034-07-11; substance patent expired 2026-02-14; entry unannounced.
loe.note_zh: 橙皮书:用途专利US11273171/US11491176于2034-07-11到期;活性成分专利已于2026-02-14到期;上市时间未公布。

rows.v_note_zh: 截至2026年3月31日的FY2025：报告产品销售额JPY 77.6bn；按公司FY2025实际平均汇率JPY 151/USD折算（业绩演示材料，第5-6页）。

loe.note: Partner Pfizer 2025 10-K: basic product patent expires 2033. No biosimilar-entry announcement.
loe.note_zh: 合作方Pfizer 2025年10-K:基础产品专利于2033年到期。无生物类似药上市公告。

loe.note: PMDA eight-year re-examination; calculated end 2029-09-26 using approval 2021-09-27 confirmed by Astellas (https://amn.astellas.jp/content/dam/jp/amn/jp/ja/di/doc/Pdfs/DocNo202211240_y.pdf?redirect=false). No biosimilar-launch date.
